from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = 4
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    def spans(size, cuts):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut:
                result.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result
    rows, cols = spans(h, row_cuts), spans(w, col_cuts)
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    template = None
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            block = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if any(v not in (bg, divider) for row in block for v in row):
                template = block
                break
        if template is not None:
            break
    if template is None:
        return grid
    for r0, r1 in rows:
        for c0, c1 in cols:
            if r1-r0 != len(template) or c1-c0 != len(template[0]):
                continue
            block = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if all(v == bg for row in block for v in row):
                for dr in range(len(template)):
                    grid[r0+dr][c0:c1] = template[dr][:]
    return grid
'''
